name: Transmittance of Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method establishing that the image formation model of Gaussian Splatting (alpha-blending) is equivalent to a ray-marching volumetric rendering model under assumptions of statistical independence and non-overlapping Gaussian primitives.
summary: Transmittance of Gaussian Splatting is a method proving 3D Gaussian Splatting is mathematically equivalent to ray-marching volumetric rendering, bridging discrete rasterization and continuous volume rendering.
